listing.name: Galactic Markets
listing.summary: Adds tools to check commodity shortages, surpluses, and price fluctuations, with side intel tracking.
listing.aiSummary: Adds tools to check commodity shortages, surpluses, and price fluctuations, with side intel tracking.

description:
Galactic Markets

Economy services for Starsector

Galactic Markets is a utility mod that allows to check shortages and surpluses, as well as low and high prices of any commodity. Additionally, it allows to track this information in the form of side intel.

Economy services for Starsector

Galactic Markets is a utility mod that allows to check shortages and surpluses, as well as low and high prices of any commodity. Additionally, it allows to track this information in the form of side intel.
aiDescription: Adds functionality to monitor commodity shortages and surpluses, as well as low and high prices across the galaxy. Tracks this data as side intel, helping players make informed economic decisions. Designed as a utility for managing in-game economies and trade strategies.
